Guided demo · sample data

This is a guided demonstration on sample figures for a fictional company. Pick a question to see how Haseeb answers inside the product.

Which customers still owe us?

Three customers owe you 12,450.000 KWD in total. The largest is Example Trading Co. W.L.L., invoice 7012, 8,000.000 KWD, due last week.

How much cash do we have right now?

142,850.000 KWD across your two bank accounts today. Your biggest upcoming payment is payroll at the end of the month.

How are this month's numbers?

Net income is 9,230.160 KWD this month. Revenue is up 14%, mostly the new consulting contract, while expenses rose with April's rent.

In the product, answers come from your own books. These are sample figures.
